import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
RNA_C=[33,34,49,94,97,99,103,104,108,115,128,134,138,141,142,145,146,149,150,153,154,174,175,176,177,179,182,210,234,237,239,350,377,434,438,439,441]
PRO_C=[18,29,78,93,94,95,97,98,164,165,166,169,173,185,189,190,193,196,198,199,201,219,220,221,222,224,259,260,261,262,263,370,377,378,379,382,383,386,393,394,395,396,401,403,404,405,406,408,409,411,412,421,422,424,425,426,427,428,429,430,431,432,433,435,436,438,439,440,441,442,443,444,445,446,447,448,457,459,460,462]
ORTH={'Q9UJA5':'human','Q8CE96':'mouse','Q2T9V5':'cow','Q6DF58':'frog (X. tropicalis)','Q32LR0':'zebrafish',
      'Q7KTM0':'fly (D. melanogaster)','Q54UB1':'Dictyostelium','Q9HGL4':'S. pombe','P41814':'S. cerevisiae'}
seqs={a:''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]) for a in ORTH}
hum=seqs['Q9UJA5']; others=[a for a in ORTH if a!='Q9UJA5']
B="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
RAW="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
MAT=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in RAW.strip().split("\n")],float)
I={c:i for i,c in enumerate(B)}
def enc(s): return np.array([I.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def nw_vec(s1,s2,g=-8.0):
    """global NW, linear gap, vectorised forward pass + scalar traceback"""
    a,b=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0), MAT[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]], -1.0)
    M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); M[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); M[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1)
    jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        T=np.empty(m+1); T[0]=M[i-1,0]+g
        T[1:]=np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1], M[i-1,1:]+g)
        U=T-g*jj; M[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(U)+g*jj
    pairs=[]; i,j=n,m
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(M[i,j]-(M[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(M[i,j]-(M[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
cons=np.zeros(len(hum)); gid={}
for acc in others:
    pr=nw_vec(hum,seqs[acc]); idn=0
    for i,j in pr:
        if hum[i]==seqs[acc][j]: idn+=1; cons[i]+=1
    gid[acc]=100*idn/len(pr)
frac=cons/len(others)
print("Global identity to human TRMT6 (BLOSUM62, linear gap -8):")
for acc in others: print(f"  {ORTH[acc]:24} {gid[acc]:5.1f} %  ({len(seqs[acc])} aa)")
def stat(lst,name):
    v=np.array([frac[r-1] for r in lst]); inv=[r for r in lst if frac[r-1]==1.0]
    print(f"  {name:30} n={len(lst):3}  mean {100*v.mean():5.1f} %  median {100*np.median(v):5.1f} %  invariant in all 8: {len(inv)}")
    return v,inv
other=sorted(set(range(1,len(hum)+1))-set(RNA_C)-set(PRO_C))
print(f"\nConservation of TRMT6 interface residues, human against 8 orthologs (to S. cerevisiae):")
vr,invr=stat(RNA_C,'tRNA-contacting'); vp,invp=stat(PRO_C,'TRMT61A-contacting'); vo,invo=stat(other,'neither')
u,p=mannwhitneyu(vr,vo,alternative='greater');   print(f"\n  tRNA-contacting vs neither    : one-sided p={p:.2e}, A={u/(len(vr)*len(vo)):.2f}")
u2,p2=mannwhitneyu(vp,vo,alternative='greater'); print(f"  TRMT61A-contacting vs neither : one-sided p={p2:.2e}, A={u2/(len(vp)*len(vo)):.2f}")
u3,p3=mannwhitneyu(vr,vp,alternative='two-sided');print(f"  tRNA- vs TRMT61A-contacting   : two-sided p={p3:.3f}, A={u3/(len(vr)*len(vp)):.2f}")
print(f"\n  background mean identity over all {len(hum)} positions: {100*frac.mean():.1f} %")
print(f"\n  tRNA-contacting residues invariant in all 8 orthologs ({len(invr)}): "
      + ', '.join(f'{hum[r-1]}{r}' for r in invr))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,4.8),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[2.4,1]})
ax=axes[0]
colmap={'tRNA':'#c05621','TRMT61A':'#2f855a','none':'#cbd5e0'}
cl=['tRNA' if i+1 in set(RNA_C) else ('TRMT61A' if i+1 in set(PRO_C) else 'none') for i in range(len(hum))]
ax.bar(range(1,len(hum)+1),100*frac,color=[colmap[c] for c in cl],width=1.0)
ax.axhline(100*frac.mean(),color='k',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.text(5,100*frac.mean()+2,f'background {100*frac.mean():.0f} %',fontsize=8)
for r in invr: ax.plot(r,103,'v',color='#c05621',ms=4)
ax.set_xlabel('TRMT6 residue (Q9UJA5)'); ax.set_ylabel('% identity across 8 orthologs')
ax.set_title('Conservation of TRMT6 along the sequence; triangles mark invariant tRNA contacts',fontsize=11)
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=colmap[k]) for k in ['tRNA','TRMT61A','none']]
ax.legend(hs,['contacts tRNA','contacts TRMT61A','neither'],fontsize=8,ncol=3,loc='lower right'); ax.set_ylim(0,110)
ax=axes[1]
bp=ax.boxplot([100*vr,100*vp,100*vo],labels=['tRNA\ncontacts','TRMT61A\ncontacts','neither'],patch_artist=True,widths=.6)
for patch,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#c05621','#2f855a','#cbd5e0']): patch.set_facecolor(c)
ax.set_ylabel('% identity across 8 orthologs')
ax.set_title(f'both interfaces conserved above background\n(tRNA vs neither p={p:.1e})',fontsize=10)
ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
